decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw in order to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent. By using a combination of control elements like Counterspell and Snuff Out, along with card advantage from cards like Augur of Bolas and Brainstorm, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with cards like Murmuring Mystic and Tolarian Terror. The Dimir Control archetype focuses on controlling the game tempo and resource advantage to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removal, and card draw. Using creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Faerie Seer to disrupt the opponent's plans, while also featuring cards like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours for card advantage. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Cast Down and Snuff Out, along with counter magic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to keep the opponent in check. The deck also includes some alternate win conditions like Murmuring Mystic and Gurmag Angler.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt opponent's strategy while having card advantage through various ways, such as countering spells, bouncing creatures, and drawing cards. The deck combines removal spells, counter spells, and creatures with evasion to control the game and ultimately win through incremental advantage. The deck utilizes cards like Spellstutter Sprite and Augur of Bolas to disrupt opponent's spells, while utilizing spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down to deal with threats. The deck also uses card draw spells like Preordain and Brainstorm to maintain card advantage and ensure consistency.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, utilizing a combination of cheap and efficient cards to deal damage as quickly as possible. The deck includes a mix of creatures that can come out early and hit hard, along with burn spells to finish off the opponent or clear the way for attacks. By utilizing a low mana curve and focusing on dealing damage swiftly, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize or mount a defense.

The deck focuses on quickly dropping artifacts onto the battlefield to power up creatures, especially with the enchantment All That Glitters. Using cards like Thoughtcast and Glint Hawk to draw cards and efficiently mana ramp, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite. With Galvanic Blast as a removal option and Wrenn's Resolve providing protection, this Aggro - Affinity deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt, countering opponent's spells with Counterspell, and drawing cards with Augur of Bolas and Mulldrifter. Ephemerate is used to blink creatures like Archaeomancer for recursion, while the mana base includes snow-covered lands for synergy with Skred. The deck also includes a variety of utility spells like Cleansing Wildfire and Brainstorm. Lórien Revealed can provide card advantage, while other cards like Destroy Evil and Dawnbringer Cleric offer additional control options and utility.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of cycling creatures and self-milling spells to fill the graveyard with creatures, allowing for powerful graveyard recursion spells like Reaping the Graves to bring back multiple creatures at once. The deck also includes mana acceleration spells like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to help quickly cast these spells, as well as tools like Lotus Petal to further enable explosive turns. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and repeated recursion of key creatures.

The main theme of this deck is to maintain control over the game by using counter spells, removal, and faeries to disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck focuses on card advantage, with card draw and recurring creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours. It also utilizes a mix of spells and creatures to maintain board presence and deal damage when needed. The deck contains a variety of versatile spells and creatures to adapt to different matchups and maintain control over the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and use cards like Exhume and Dread Return to bring powerful creatures back onto the battlefield, creating a strong board presence. The deck also utilizes cards like Acorn Harvest and Gnaw to the Bone to gain value and maintain resources. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of reanimation spells and powerful creatures, ultimately leading to victory through a fast and efficient reanimator strategy.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt opponents' game plans by countering spells, removing threats, and maintaining card advantage through card draw and card selection. The deck utilizes efficient counterspells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite, removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down, and card draw spells like Preordain and Behold the Multiverse. Additionally, the deck includes creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Augur of Bolas to generate card advantage and apply pressure. The goal is to control the game until the opponent runs out of resources and win with powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to maintain board advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient creatures like Augur of Bolas and Spellstutter Sprite while using cards like Lórien Revealed and Faerie Seer to filter through the deck. The inclusion of cards like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Thorn of the Black Rose provide additional card advantage and help generate incremental value. The deck excels at managing resources and gaining incremental advantages over time.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful enchantments that boost their abilities. By utilizing efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher, along with removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace while also controlling the board. Additionally, cards like All That Glitters and Lembas provide additional power and resilience to the creatures, allowing them to deal significant damage to the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of efficient counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes a Faerie subtheme with creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Ninja of the Deep Hours, providing additional card advantage and tempo plays. The inclusion of a few key finishers like Gurmag Angler and Thorn of the Black Rose ensure that the deck can close out the game once it has established control.

The main concept of this deck is to use Turbo Fog cards like Moment's Peace and Fog to stall the game and prevent damage, while generating card advantage with cards like Accumulated Knowledge and Lórien Revealed. The deck aims to dig through the library quickly with cards like Behold the Multiverse and Growth Spiral, and combo off with cards like Words of Wisdom and Stream of Thought to create a massive amount of mana for a game-winning play. The deck also has control elements like Arcane Denial and Tangle to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. The key strategy is to continually generate card advantage through Mulldrifter, Augur of Bolas, and Ephemerate, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Skred. The inclusion of Archaeomancer allows for recursion of key instants and sorceries, while the Kenku Artificer and Murmuring Mystic provide additional threats. The deck aims to control the board and win through incremental advantage and resource management.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to slow down the opponent's game plan using a variety of control spells like Counterspell, Skred, and Lightning Bolt, while also generating card advantage with cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Augur of Bolas. The deck aims to establish control of the game through counter magic and removal spells, while also leveraging card draw and board presence with creatures like Murmuring Mystic and Lórien Revealed. The deck also utilizes lands that can generate multiple colors of mana to provide flexibility in casting spells.
